notes: v622 — CLEANUP TOOL for the v620 bug's real damage. If repeated clicks on the old broken instant-sell button left duplicate trade records and inflated cash — exactly what happened with your SNAS position — there's now a fix for it. In 💼 Portfolio, under Trade history: '🧹 Check for & remove duplicate trades'. It shows exactly what it found and the exact cash correction BEFORE doing anything, keeps one record per group, removes the rest, and reverses only the extra cash those duplicates credited. It only ever touches records that are identical in every field — a real, separate trade is never at risk. It also checks whether a matching position is still sitting in your holdings and flags it rather than touching it automatically. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
